description: Opus S unit 3: Commander at the battle start. Tatsugiri and Dondozo lead: Tatsugiri's onAnySwitchIn commands (commanding / commanded, Dondozo +2 in every stat). The turn: Tatsugiri passes; Garchomp's Dragon Claw at Tatsugiri misses (hitStepInvulnerabilityEvent); Dondozo (Eject Button, bench Snorlax) U-turns Garchomp without switching out (selfSwitch is off for a commanded user); Sylveon's Dazzling Gleam hits only Dondozo, whose Eject Button stays (commanded).
